title: Musicians, Singers Struggle in the Digital Age
main_content:
People can listen to music on many devices, including tablets and mobile phones. As music becomes digital, billions of people around the world can listen to many different kinds of songs no matter where they live – the variety and quantity of music is greater than ever before, and available to more people.

These changes are both good news and bad news for the music industry. They help spread music around the world. But digitizing music can create problems for songwriters, musicians and singers.

Alexandre Lombard listens to music online. He says young people do not want to pay to listen to digitized songs.

“We have the opportunity to access almost every piece of music that ever existed. For my generation, music has always been available for free. Some way or another you could access free music on the Internet.”

Experts believe musical creativity will increase because of the Internet, but only if the artists are paid for their work.

questions.question: What is good about music becoming digital?
options: It allows people to listen to only one genre of music.
It makes music accessible to billions of people worldwide.
It reduces the number of songs available for listening.
It ensures artists are paid fairly for every streamed song.
questions.answer: It makes music accessible to billions of people worldwide.

questions.question: What is bad about music becoming digital?
options: It limits the variety of music available.
It makes it harder for songwriters and musicians to earn money.
It increases the quality of music recordings.
It prevents listeners from accessing music offline.
questions.answer: It makes it harder for songwriters and musicians to earn money.

questions.question: What do the experts think will happen to musical creativity?
options: Musical creativity will decline as fewer people listen to music.
Musical creativity will flourish if artists are compensated for their work.
Musical creativity will only improve with more expensive music production.
Musical creativity will remain the same regardless of payment.
questions.answer: Musical creativity will flourish if artists are compensated for their work.
